column2: Thanks to the generosity of neighbors, the family had enough food for winter.
column3: 多虧鄰居的慷慨，這家人有足夠的食物過冬。
column4: show great generosity (表現出極大慷慨)
column5: generous 大方 + ity → 大方的美德

column2: Soap kills every germ on your hands before lunch.
column3: 肥皂能在午餐前殺死你手上的每一個細菌。
column5: germ 像「真媽」：真的媽媽叫你洗手，因為細菌看不見

column2: Parents cried happy tears at the graduation ceremony in June.
column3: 六月的畢業典禮上，家長流下開心的眼淚。
column5: grade 年級 + uate：念完所有年級，戴帽子丟上天

column2: He wrote a letter to show his gratitude to the nurse who helped him.
column3: 他寫了一封信，向幫助過他的護理師表達感激。
column5: grat 令人愉快 + itude：心裡暖暖的感謝

column2: The shop owner gave us a warm greeting at the door.
column3: 店老闆在門口熱情地向我們打招呼。
column5: greet 打招呼 + ing → 見面時說的那句話

column2: The whole town shared the family's grief after the fire destroyed their home.
column3: 大火燒毀他們的家後，全鎮人都分擔這家人的悲痛。
column5: grief 和 relief 對照：relief 鬆口氣，grief 心沉沉

column2: The groom smiled at his bride as they walked out of the church.
column3: 新郎走出教堂時，對著新娘微笑。
column5: groom 的 room 像新房，新郎住進新房

column2: Ships sail across the gulf to reach the port on the other side.
column3: 船隻橫越海灣，抵達對岸的港口。
column5: gulf 像「咕」：海水咕嚕咕嚕灌進陸地的大缺口

column2: A gull followed the fishing boat, hoping to catch a snack.
column3: 一隻海鷗跟著漁船，希望能撈到點心。
column4: a flock of gulls (一群海鷗)
column5: gull 像「蓋兒」：海鷗在你頭上叫，快蓋住食物

column2: Her neat handwriting makes her notes easy to read.
column3: 她工整的字跡讓筆記很容易閱讀。
column5: hand 手 + writing 寫字 → 用手寫出來的樣子

column2: The family endured great hardship during the long drought.
column3: 在漫長的乾旱期間，這家人忍受了極大的艱難。
column5: hard 硬 + ship 狀態 → 硬邦邦難熬的日子

column2: He plays a sweet tune on the harmonica every evening.
column3: 他每天傍晚用口琴吹奏一首甜美的曲子。
column5: harmony 和聲 + ica：嘴巴橫著吹出和諧的聲音

column2: In his haste, he left his lunch box on the bus.
column3: 他匆忙之中，把便當盒忘在公車上。
column5: haste 和 hasty 一家，趕時間就匆匆忙忙

column2: Years of war left the two villages with deep hatred for each other.
column3: 多年戰爭讓兩個村莊彼此懷有深深的仇恨。
column5: hate 討厭 + red 紅 → 氣到臉紅脖子粗，就是憎恨

column2: I put on my headphone and shut out the noise from the street.
column3: 我戴上耳機，把街上的噪音隔絕在外。
column5: head 頭 + phone 聽筒 → 戴在頭上的聽筒

column2: After ten years abroad, she finally returned to her homeland.
column3: 在國外十年後，她終於回到祖國。
column4: return to the homeland (回到家鄉)
column5: home 家 + land 土地 → 自己家的那塊土地

column2: Every household in the town received a free mask from the government.
column3: 鎮上每戶人家都從政府那裡領到一個免費口罩。
column5: house 房子 + hold 住著 → 同住一屋的一家人

column2: My neighbor is a housewife who also sells cakes online.
column3: 我的鄰居是家庭主婦，同時也在網路上賣蛋糕。
column4: a busy housewife (忙碌的家庭主婦)
column5: house 房子 + wife 太太 → 顧家的太太

column2: The doctor treated every patient with kindness and humanity.
column3: 醫生以善意和人道精神對待每位病人。
column5: human 人 + ity：身為「人」該有的溫暖

column2: High humidity in summer makes the air feel sticky.
column3: 夏天的高濕度讓空氣感覺黏黏的。
column5: humid 潮濕 + ity → 空氣中有多濕的程度

column2: Water is made of oxygen and hydrogen.
column3: 水是由氧和氫組成的。
column5: hydro 水 + gen 產生 → 能生出水的元素

column2: Only the tip of the iceberg can be seen above the water.
column3: 海面上只看得到冰山的一角。
column4: the tip of the iceberg (冰山一角)
column5: ice 冰 + berg 山 → 浮在海上的冰山

column2: The police asked for identification before letting him enter the building.
column3: 警方要他先出示身分證明才讓他進入大樓。
column5: identify 認出 + ation → 證明你是誰的東西
column7: i - den - ti - fi - ca - tion

column2: The idiom "a piece of cake" means something is very easy.
column3: 成語「小事一樁」的意思是事情很簡單。
column5: idiom 的意思藏在字面下，不能一個字一個字翻

column2: The boy hung a poster of his favorite singer, his idol, on the wall.
column3: 男孩在牆上掛了他最愛的歌手、也就是他的偶像的海報。
column5: idol 像「愛豆」：愛吃豆的人也愛偶像

column2: The book has a clear illustration that explains how a volcano erupts.
column3: 這本書有張清楚的圖解，說明火山如何爆發。
column5: illustrate 圖解 + ion → 一張把意思畫出來的圖

column2: The new immigrant learned the language quickly and found a job.
column3: 這位新移民很快學會當地語言並找到工作。
column5: im 進入 + migrate 遷移 → 搬進來的人

column2: Immigration to the country has risen sharply in the past decade.
column3: 過去十年，移入該國的人口大幅增加。
column5: im 進入 + migrate 遷移 + ion → 搬進來住的現象

column2: Dark clouds are an indication that rain is coming.
column3: 烏雲是快要下雨的跡象。
column5: indicate 指出 + ion → 手指指向答案的信號

column2: The infant slept quietly in her mother's arms.
column3: 嬰兒安靜地睡在媽媽懷裡。
column5: in 不 + fant 說話 → 還不會說話的小寶寶

column2: Cover your mouth when you cough to prevent the spread of infection.
column3: 咳嗽時要遮住嘴巴，避免感染擴散。
column5: infect 傳染 + ion → 病菌從一個人跳到另一個人

column2: Fresh milk is the main ingredient in this ice cream.
column3: 新鮮牛奶是這種冰淇淋的主要成分。
column5: in 在裡面 + gredi 走 + ent：走進鍋子裡的材料

column2: The child's innocence touched everyone who watched her sing.
column3: 孩子的純真打動了每一位看她唱歌的人。
column5: in 沒有 + nocent 傷害 → 不會傷人的天真

column2: The intensity of the storm forced the airport to close for a day.
column3: 暴風雨的強度之大，迫使機場關閉一天。
column5: intense 強烈 + ity → 強烈到什麼程度

column2: Group projects give students the chance for more interaction with classmates.
column3: 分組專題讓學生有更多機會與同學互動。
column5: inter 彼此 + action 行動 → 你動我也動

column2: The loud phone call caused an interruption in the middle of the lesson.
column3: 吵鬧的電話在課堂中間造成了干擾。
column5: inter 之間 + rupt 斷裂 → 從中間斷開

column2: Her rising intonation at the end of the sentence showed she was asking a question.
column3: 她句尾上揚的語調顯示她在發問。
column5: in 在 + tone 音調 + ation → 聲音的高低起伏

column2: The invasion of the island started at dawn.
column3: 對這座島的入侵在黎明時開始。
column5: in 進入 + vade 走進 → 未經允許闖進別人的地方

column2: The mayor's involvement in the park project helped it finish on time.
column3: 市長參與公園計畫，讓工程如期完成。
column5: in 在裡面 + volve 捲 → 把自己捲進事情裡

column2: The sick patient was kept in isolation so others would not catch the cold.
column3: 生病的病人被隔離，以免其他人感冒。
column5: isle 小島 + ation：像被丟到孤島上，與世隔絕
